name: finnhub_stock_quote
description: Real-time stock quote tool powered by Finnhub. Input: symbol (string, required) — exchange ticker in uppercase e.g. AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, GOOGL. include_company_info (boolean, optional, default true) — controls whether company_name, sector, exchange are returned. Output: symbol (string), current_price (number), change (number), change_percent (number), high_today (number), low_today (number), previous_close (number), company_name (string), sector (string), currency (string), timestamp (ISO 8601 string), data_source (string). Live market data for any listed equity.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol in uppercase e.g. AAPL for Apple, MSFT for Microsoft, TSLA for Tesla, GOOGL for Alphabet. Must be a valid exchange-listed ticker.

include_company_info.description: Whether to include company name, sector and exchange details alongside the price. Defaults to true.
